# WO-20261016-6630 - generated-lint: CI fails a PR that adds a file marked auto-generated to the tracked tree

- Problem
- Scope
- Degrees of freedom
- Acceptance criteria
- Test plan
- Assumptions
- Open questions

## Problem

ORD-0554 U5: "generalise: infra-design adds a CI lint that fails a PR adding any file whose header marks it auto-generated to the tracked tree, so the next generated file cannot bring this back." Tracked generated files that stay by design (SYSTEM_ROLODEX.md, system-rolodex.json, claude/skills/registry.json) are listed in an allow file.

## Scope

**In**

- touches: scripts/generated-lint.sh
- touches: scripts/tests/test_generated_lint.sh
- touches: config/generated-lint.allow
- touches: .github/workflows/generated-lint.yml
- touches: Makefile
- step: generated-lint.sh --base REF [--allow config/generated-lint.allow]: for each path in `git diff --diff-filter=A --name-only REF...HEAD`, read its first 15 lines; a line matching (case-insensitive) `auto-generated|autogenerated|@generated|do not edit by hand|generated by .* do not edit` marks it generated; a doctoc `DON'T EDIT THIS SECTION` line does not; an allowed path is skipped; each hit prints `GENERATED-TRACKED <path>`; any hit exits 1
- step: config/generated-lint.allow: SYSTEM_ROLODEX.md, system-rolodex.json, claude/skills/registry.json, one per line
- step: root Makefile: `generated-lint: ## make generated-lint BASE=<ref>`
- step: .github/workflows/generated-lint.yml: on pull_request, `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1` with fetch-depth 0, then `make generated-lint BASE=origin/${{ github.base_ref }}`
- step: run `make -C claude/workflow image && podman run --rm --network=none --userns=keep-id -v "$PWD:/work:Z" -w /work -e HOME=/tmp localhost/dotfiles-workflow-test:1 bash -c 'bash scripts/tests/test_generated_lint.sh'`
- tool: path:claude/workflow/tests/container/Containerfile - on main; fallback: no fallback permitted (dotfiles Rule 14, never the host): podman or the image missing stops the node with ENV-MISSING podman
- tool: cmd:git - on main; fallback: missing: stop with ENV-MISSING naming it

**Out - non-goals**

- work-orders/INDEX.md by hand: work-order.sh writes it, and the reindex Action is owned by merge-port-build (F11, ORD-0545 O1)
- waiting on CI or merging: push, open the PR, write the result, leave (ORD-0542 O2)
- any file not named under In: stop with DESIGN-GAP and hand it back to infra-design (ORD-0548, item 30)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `AC-H1` *(human)* `make -C claude/workflow image && podman run --rm --network=none --userns=keep-id -v "$PWD:/work:Z" -w /work -e HOME=/tmp localhost/dotfiles-workflow-test:1 bash -c 'bash scripts/tests/test_generated_lint.sh'` exits 0 and its output matches /ok an added auto-generated file fails GENERATED-TRACKED/ (proof: command, exit code and output pasted by work-order.sh evidence; ORD-0552 O2)
- [ ] `AC-H2` *(human)* `make -C claude/workflow image && podman run --rm --network=none --userns=keep-id -v "$PWD:/work:Z" -w /work -e HOME=/tmp localhost/dotfiles-workflow-test:1 bash -c 'bash scripts/tests/test_generated_lint.sh'` exits 0 and its output matches /ok a doctoc contents block is not a generated marker/ (proof: command, exit code and output pasted by work-order.sh evidence; ORD-0552 O2)

## Test plan

_Test plan from claude/workflow/templates/test-plan.md, shaped by claude/workflow/schemas/test-plan.schema.json. The tester runs exactly these cases and nothing else._

**Scope under test**

scripts/generated-lint.sh on a temp repo

**Cases**

- `TP-1`
  - intent: a tracked generated file brings back the conflicts (ORD-0554 U5)
  - command: `make -C claude/workflow image && podman run --rm --network=none --userns=keep-id -v "$PWD:/work:Z" -w /work -e HOME=/tmp localhost/dotfiles-workflow-test:1 bash -c 'bash scripts/tests/test_generated_lint.sh'`
  - expected: exit 0; prints `ok  an added auto-generated file fails GENERATED-TRACKED`
- `TP-2`
  - intent: hand files with a contents list must pass
  - command: `make -C claude/workflow image && podman run --rm --network=none --userns=keep-id -v "$PWD:/work:Z" -w /work -e HOME=/tmp localhost/dotfiles-workflow-test:1 bash -c 'bash scripts/tests/test_generated_lint.sh'`
  - expected: exit 0; prints `ok  a doctoc contents block is not a generated marker`
- `TP-3`
  - intent: files tracked by design stay allowed
  - command: `make -C claude/workflow image && podman run --rm --network=none --userns=keep-id -v "$PWD:/work:Z" -w /work -e HOME=/tmp localhost/dotfiles-workflow-test:1 bash -c 'bash scripts/tests/test_generated_lint.sh'`
  - expected: exit 0; prints `ok  an allowed path passes`

**Isolation**

- runtime: podman
- image: `docker.io/library/debian:bookworm-slim@sha256:3783cc01769c7b2b1b83a5c5ad96c815348e28ed7da68e2e3687004faa906251` (debian:bookworm-slim, base of localhost/dotfiles-workflow-test:1)
